Oliver (Customer): Hey team — during our devkit onboarding we're getting a ton of 429s. Started when we rolled the web-embedded SDK to staging. Looks like a fanout of preflight/init calls. Renewal review next week so this is urgent.
Anya (CS): Sorry to hear — can you paste the first error lines and confirm SDK version + where it's running (lambda, container, mobile)?
Oliver (Customer): SDK v1.2.0, running in lambda warmup. Example from logs: `POST /v1/init 429 rate_limit_exceeded` — we see ~150 parallel init requests on cold starts.
Mike (SRE): That pattern is classic preflight storm + ephemeral token stampede. Are you minting ephemeral tokens per-request or per-session?
Oliver (Customer): Per-request. We thought it was safer because sessions are short-lived.
Sofia (SDK Eng): Quick checklist: 1) prefer reuse per session (cache token for 30–120s), 2) add randomized jitter before preflight, 3) implement a simple circuit breaker (fail fast after N 429s), 4) batch or queue init calls on warmup. Small snippet:
```js
// naive jittered init
async function getToken(){
  if(tokenCache.valid) return tokenCache.val;
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.random()*500));
  return fetch('/init')
}
```
Sofia (SDK Eng): And a minimal backoff loop: `await sleep((2**attempt)*100 + Math.random()*100)` — prevents synchronized retry spikes.
Anya (CS): I can request a temporary burst increase on your account for onboarding. Can you DM me the account ID and desired window (hours)?
Oliver (Customer): Account OLVR-7731. We only need ~48h of higher burst while we roll the patched client.
Mike (SRE): On our side we can enable a soft buffer queue for preflight/handshake traffic to convert hard 429s into a controlled backpressure. Need a small repro (wrk script or k6) that simulates the 150 parallel inits.
Oliver (Customer): I'll run a k6 script this afternoon and paste results.
Sofia (SDK Eng): If changing minting is heavy for you, we can cut a patched devkit that uses session-level reuse + adaptive circuit breaker. ETA ~24h for a canary build.
Oliver (Customer): That would help a lot — our renewal conversation cares about stability above perf right now.
Anya (CS): :thumbsup: I'll block 30m with you and Sofia tomorrow 10:00am PT to coordinate quota bump + canary rollout + run the load test together.
deploy-bot: PATCH release v1.2.1-csfix deployed to canary (10%). Monitor apdex and 429 rate for 1h.
Oliver (Customer): Noticed immediate improvement on canary — 429s dropped ~70% after switching to the patched client in staging.
Anya (CS): Great. After you finish the full rollout we'll follow up with a short postmortem and update onboarding docs with the playbook (token reuse, jitter, circuit breaker). Also capturing this as a renewal risk mitigation in the account health notes.
Oliver (Customer): Thanks everyone — will share k6 output after the full prod rollout is validated.
